experiments.title: Acid-Base Titration
experiments.subtitle: Neutralization
experiments.description: Add base from a burette into an acid flask drop by drop until the indicator changes colour, then read the burette to find the unknown concentration.

experiments.title: Flame Test
experiments.subtitle: Metal cations
experiments.description: Dip a clean wire into a salt solution and hold it in a Bunsen flame. The flame colour identifies the metal cation inside the salt.
safety: Use tongs — the wire gets hot

experiments.title: Copper Sulfate Crystals
experiments.subtitle: Hydrates & evaporation
experiments.description: Dissolve copper sulfate in hot water, let the solution cool slowly and watch blue crystals form as the water evaporates.
safety: Wash hands after handling the salt
